arStrings.szText: A slain beast coughs up an arm.

I've discovered the corpse of a kraken on the coast of Philios. Its heads lashed out, holding some terrible malice even in death. When slain, it coughed up the torn arm of a sailor.

I should find the arm's owner. They may wish to know that the beast is dead.
Bring the Chewed Arm to its owner
